What We Do

Our Roofing Services

From a slipped tile or a leaking bay roof to a full re-roof or a commercial flat roof, every job gets a free survey first.

Pitched Roofs and Re-Roofs

New roofs and full re-roofs in tile and slate, stripped back, re-felted, re-battened and finished with a dry ridge.

See more

Flat Roofing

Single-ply and rubber flat roofs, warm and cold roof builds, for extensions, garages and dormers.

See more

Commercial Roofing and Coatings

Flat roofs, coatings and planned maintenance for landlords, schools, offices, retail units and warehouses.

See more

Roof Windows

New roof windows fitted and flashed into the tiles, letting light into lofts and conversions without leaks.

See more

Roofline and Guttering

Gutters, fascias and verges put right so rainwater runs off the roof and away from the walls.

See more

Repairs and Maintenance

Leaks, slipped slates, bay roofs and storm damage found, explained and fixed, plus planned maintenance visits.

See more

Why Choose LP Roofing Ltd

Dependable roofing, good materials and straight answers. We survey the roof first, tell you what it really needs, and keep you informed from the first visit to the final inspection.

  • Free Roof Surveys

    We come out, get up on the roof and give you a no-obligation quote for what it actually needs.

  • Kept Informed Throughout

    You know what is happening at every stage, from your first enquiry to the final inspection.

  • Flat and Pitched

    Tile and slate, plus single-ply and rubber flat roofs in warm and cold roof builds.

  • Homes and Businesses

    Homeowners, landlords, letting agents and property managers, through to schools, offices and warehouses.

  • Local to Accrington

    Based at Junction 7 Business Park in Clayton-le-Moors, working across Lancashire and the Fylde.

About Us

The Team Behind LP Roofing Ltd

LP Roofing Ltd is run by Lee Pinder from Junction 7 Business Park in Clayton-le-Moors. The team looks after roofs on homes, rented properties and commercial buildings across Lancashire and the Fylde, from small repairs to complete replacements, protective coatings and planned maintenance.

Every job starts with a free survey and a straight answer about what the roof needs. Once the work is agreed we keep you up to date at each stage and finish with a final inspection, so you know exactly what has been done. As one customer put it, Lee "explained whole process from start to finish".

Lee PinderDirector, LP Roofing Ltd
